Fango 0.1 — :help for commands
> | | Log : effect
> | | Db : effect
> App : effect alias
> | | fetch : () ->{App} Int
> () ->{App} Int
> caller : () ->{App} Int
> () ->{App} Int
> | | | mixed : () ->{App} Int
> () ->{App} Int
> | | spelled : () ->{Db, Log} Int
> () ->{Db, Log} Int
> | | partly : () ->{Db} Int
> () ->{Db} Int
> | | -- EFFECT MISMATCH -------------------------------------- <repl>

`bare` declares `App`, but its body performs none of its effects.
Remove `App` from the annotation; a function that performs fewer effects can
still be passed wherever a `{App}` callback is expected.

1| bare : () ->{App} ()
        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
> App : effect alias
> | | narrowed : () ->{App} ()
> () ->{App} ()
> | | Fail : effect
> Risky : effect alias
> | | risky : a ->{Risky a} Int
> a ->{Risky a} Int
> atString : () ->{Risky String} Int
> () ->{Risky String} Int
> Pair : type alias
> | | swap : (a, a) -> (a, a)
> (a, a) -> (a, a)
> Pair : effect alias
> | | -- NAMING ERROR ----------------------------------------- <repl>

`Pair` is an effect alias, not a type.

1| wrong : Pair
           ^^^^

Effects go on an arrow: `A ->{Pair} B`. Another alias of them is written `alias Name = {Pair}`.
>
